entries.title: A swipe down closes the picture viewer after a double-tap on your iPhone
entries.body: On your iPhone or iPad, a swipe down could fail to close the full-screen viewer for a picture or a diagram right after a double-tap, when the viewer was still busy as you tapped. A double-tap now always zooms in or back the viewer's own way, so the swipe down that follows closes it.
entries.noPicture: The viewer looks the same; only a swipe down that sometimes did nothing after a double-tap now closes it.
